title: Well-Dressed Teen Couple, 1957 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A clear black and white square snapshot stamped JUL 57 along the right border. A smartly dressed young woman and young man stand together on a suburban lawn, possibly for a graduation or special event, as the young man holds a wrapped gift or box. A classic 1940s or early 1950s automobile is parked along the curb behind them. In the background, a man in short sleeves stands casually on the porch steps leaning against a white column. Tropical foliage and palm trees suggest a coastal or southern US location during the post-WWII suburban boom.
